summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for replay, rewards, responsive UI, and animation continuity. Backend contracts passed; frontend mostly passed with one motion-boundary issue under ~100ms sampling.

ui_bugs.issue: Motion speed bound exceeded during 40s continuity sampling at ~100ms cadence (max observed 85.53 px/s; expected <=69 px/s).

integration_issues.issue: In one run replay remained empty after 22s despite mining start; deterministic API-seeded run produced replay details correctly.

action_items: Investigate MineScene/MineMotion speed ceiling enforcement for 100ms telemetry sampling; ensure strict <=69 px/s bound in continuity checks.
Validate replay first-decision visibility timing from pure UI create/start flow (without API priming) to avoid intermittent empty state.
Keep current rewards contract: no claim actions, /api/rewards/claim 404, receipts empty/null wallet-scoped.
critical_code_review_comments: Replay API ownership, pagination, filters, invalid bearer handling, and holder-loss read behavior are correct in tested paths.
Replay record arithmetic is internally consistent: score_delta, banked/exploration/penalty deltas match before/after snapshots; score floor stayed non-negative in observed entries.
Rewards implementation correctly removed claimable semantics and uses Stonk.fun canonical URL.
Animation pause-view freeze logic works when measured between two paused snapshots; world-order/server_time perturbation did not cause teleports.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple temporary simulated wallets/agents via /api/wallets + /api/session for replay/rewards/UI validation; test cleanup fixture now also deletes decision_replays by generated agent IDs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest now covers replay contract + updated rewards contract and passes 15/15. Frontend checks confirmed: long home copy present, no claim UI, rewards overflow absent on 1920x800 and 390x844, replay populated details render on desktop/mobile when replay exists, wallet switch/disconnect clears replay access. Remaining focus: strict motion-speed bound under ~100ms sampling and intermittent replay empty-from-UI-start timing.
rca of the issue: Animation speed-bound mismatch appears during high-frequency (~100ms) sampling: observed spikes above 69 px/s though no teleport jumps >20px and perturbation handling is stable. Likely due speed interpolation/state transitions around goal updates or sampling jitter windows; mitigation is to enforce/verify per-frame displacement caps directly in motion update and add in-app diagnostics for frame-delta and per-step displacement.
mocked_api: MOCKED: Wallet/session identity and holder gating are simulated. MOCKED: GLDX on-chain receipt ingestion is intentionally disconnected (empty/null receipts by product choice).
